headline: Nothing malicious happened while we ran it the way a candidate would. That is not a guarantee.

steps.name: npm install
steps.cmd: npm rebuild --foreground-scripts; for s in preinstall install postinstall prepare; do npm run --if-present $s; done
steps.why: install runs lifecycle scripts of the project and its dependencies
